text.en:
For the purpose of correcting an error therein, the second paragraph of section twenty-six of Act
Numbered Seventeen hundred and sixty-one, referred to as The Opium Act, as amended by section two of Act
Numbered Nineteen hundred and ten, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"First. The carrying out of the provisions of this Act and the provisions of paragraph eighty of section eleven
of the Act of Congress approved March third, nineteen hundred and five, entitled 'An Act to revise and amend
the tariff laws of the Philippine Islands, and for other purposes.'"

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 6, 1912.
